content.bio: Senior fullstack and mobile developer with 8+ years of experience. I come from high-reliability systems (payments and critical integrations), and today I build complete digital products: Flutter apps, modern webs, APIs, backoffice and production deploys. Current stack: Flutter/Dart, TypeScript, Next.js/Vue, Supabase, Firebase, maps, camera, auth, notifications and applied AI. Own products: TerraLiam and App MiDoc.

services.mobileText: iOS/Android apps with Flutter: maps, camera, compass, auth, notifications, media and store releases (Play / App Store). Clean architecture, performance and production-ready UX.
services.fullstackText: Landings, dashboards and backends with TypeScript, Next.js/Vue, Supabase/Firebase, auth, storage, RLS and edge functions. From MVP to an operable product with metrics and backoffice.
services.productText: From concept to release: discovery, UI, app + web, backend, privacy/policies, CI/CD and iteration. Ideal when you need a senior who closes the full loop.

faq.a1: QuintanaDev is Juniors Quintana's software studio in Caracas, Venezuela. Senior fullstack and mobile development: Flutter apps, webs, APIs and end-to-end digital products.
faq.q2: What kind of products do you build?
faq.a2: Real apps and platforms in production or launch. For example TerraLiam (family outdoor game with maps, camera and AI) and App MiDoc (mobile clinical management for patients, doctors and admins). Also landings, Ops dashboards and Supabase/Firebase backends.
faq.a3: Use the contact form on this page. The team operates on UTC-4 (Caracas).
